title: Day trip to Tangier
text: We had a phenomenal experience with this one day excursion to Tangier. Our driver Isra and tour guide Tifo were so informative and enthusiastic that it was impossible not to make this experience memorable.
author: johnrE7718CO

title: Great taste of Morocco
text: Our trip was smooth and seamless.  The tour operator handled everything.  Our driver Javier was personable, knowledgeable and safe on the roads.  Our guide in Tanger, Karim, we amazing. He took us all around and handled all the tickets, lunches, tours etc.  it was a really great day.
author: Elizabeth_H

title: Fantastic private tour to Tangier from Seville
text: We had an outstanding full day private tour from Seville to Tangier with VIP Malaga Tours.  There were two couples in our group.  Our day started with pickup at our hotel by Luis in a comfortable van.  He took us to the port in Tarifa, where we had a little free time to shop and get a coffee while he bought our ferry tickets (and filled out all our paperwork - thank you!).  Luis then escorted us to the ferry with instructions on how to meet our private guide in Tangier. title: Aziz, our tour guide, was...
text: Aziz, our tour guide, was wonderful!  He was so knowledgeable and shared many fascinating detail of Tangier.
author: Kathy_R

title: VIP Malaga - Tangiers, Gibralter and Lisbon/Seville Driver - 10+ Stars THE BEST
text: We took 3 different tours with VIP Malaga. Mark was a fantastic communicator and made all of our arrangements custom as we requested. First we worked with them to drive us from Lisbon to Seville. Mark secured a great driver and arranged that we could stop for lunch and sight seeing in Evora - it was wonderful! Next we had two separate tours over two days. First Luis (who was just the best!!) drove us from Seville to Gibralter and then made sure we got across the border and met our guide in Gibralter.
